method.what: For every fit that froze a shipped coordinate (the S1 record's identification.fit; B41 for the fed 3-deoxy triangle the record names B39; B21 for its two analogue-tier rows), the fit's own residual function imported from its frozen wave generator, at its frozen point: one objective evaluation (S = r . r, rows then and now), the forward-difference Jacobian (one evaluation per free coordinate, absolute per-kind steps: log10 k 0.05, Ea 2 kJ/mol, pH slope 0.05, pKa 0.1, acid yield 0.01, logit 0.05), and one bounded Gauss-Newton step evaluated (backtracked at most twice). No optimiser runs.
method.classes: REPRODUCES: |S_today - S_recorded| <= tol x max(1, S_recorded) (the record's stated tolerance, else 1 %) and the same row count. DRIFTED-BENIGN: not reproduced, but the evaluated one-step decrease is below chi2_p(0.95) x s2 (p = the fit's free coordinates) AND every shipped coordinate's quadratic marginal Delta_j = d_S' C_SS^-1 d_S <= chi2_|S|(0.95) x s2 (d the Gauss-Newton step, C = (J'J)^+), AND the quadratic model those tests use holds at the evaluated step (trust ratio = evaluated / predicted decrease >= 0.25). The marginal tests are Bonferroni-adjusted over the fit's m shipped coordinates (threshold chi2_|S|(1 - 0.05 / m) x s2; the unadjusted 95 % verdicts are reported too). DRIFTED-UNRESOLVED: the joint and marginal tests pass but the trust ratio fails (near-optimality not shown: no support, but no evidence against). DRIFTED-MATERIAL: the joint test or a marginal fails. s2 = max(1, chi2_red at the freeze), never today's chi2_red (a drift must not widen its own tolerance). Where the fit's frozen setting does not converge (B2.3's quick pH fixed point), S is reproduced at the frozen setting and the Jacobian and step are evaluated at the converged one.
method.limits: Local: the one-step decrease is a LOWER bound on S_frozen - S_min (a material verdict on it is certain), while a benign verdict rests on the quadratic model at the frozen point, which a strongly curved objective can understate; the S1 profile run's refits (PR #106) are the global check where they exist. Rows then come from each report's own row table; B1 keeps none (per-response summaries only) and B60 keeps residuals without targets. Identification bookkeeping, never credit; changes no tier, register or constant.
